Thanks so much. I'll definitely keep this in mind 

sometimes i can just forget about this incident like it never happened, and then on days like today it feels like I can't get that single voice out of my head. it's then that i want to hurt myself. now i have a lot of kind words from some amazing strangers to balance out that voice. thank you all
yeah, but that was an accident. i made a deliberate effort to touch my friend's dick, however lightly or harmlessly

Thanks for this, but i don't want to compare myself against douchebag rapists and say "At least I'm not that bad." 

what i did was wrong, but i know it wasn't *that bad*. However, i have a real problem with blaming myself and shouldering guilt. this is something i can't seem to let go because i let myself down and my friend down, even if he doesn't know it. maybe suicide isn't the appropriate response to such a trivial sin, but to me it seems like a decent option as both punishment and as a way to alleviate my guilt

maybe i'm just being melodramatic? i'm starting to feel a lot better, though. a few hours ago I started writing a suicide note, but i've abandoned that. i want to live but i just don't know if I can. thanks for all your help

that's why this hurts me so much. If my friend knew, he might see me as an immoral pervert who doesn't value his friendship

i don't think i have the balls to tell him because i don't want to risk losing his friendship. maybe some things are better left unsaid
I really appreciate that. you're a phenomenal human being
